Abstract. We establish formulas for the Hilbert series of the Feichtner–Yuzvinsky Chow
ring of a polymatroid using arbitrary building sets. For braid matroids and minimal
building sets, our results produce new formulas for the Poincar´e polynomial of the mod-
of pointed stable rational curves, and recover several previous results by
Keel, Getzler, Manin, and Aluffi–Marcolli–Nascimento. We also use our methods to pro-
duce examples of matroids and building sets for which the corresponding Chow ring has
Hilbert series with non-log-concave coefficients. This contrasts with the real-rootedness
and log-concavity conjectures of Ferroni–Schr¨oter for matroids with maximal building
sets, and of Aluffi–Chen–Marcolli for braid matroids with minimal building sets.
